title: Fire Potion

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Gain 30 minutes immunity to Fire and Heat (Not Lava)

body:
"After drinking this mysterious fiery potion(and potentially burning your tongue), you'll gain 30 minutes of immunity to all fire and heat (not lava)"


Description

The Fire Potion can be purchased at the Magma Cave Store located in the Magma Caves for $15,000 . The fire potion allows the user to gain immunity from heat and fire, but not from lava.

Appearance

The Fire Potion looks as the name suggests. It is a glass potion bottle in the shape of a flame design, with a cork inserted into the bottle. The cork has a fire ornament attached to its top. The liquid inside has the glow and appearance of magma found in Oaklands.
